content:
30 seconds, vertical 9:16. An extremely photorealistic, ultra-high-resolution live-action film featuring a real contemporary interior, real adult male and female actors, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, physically accurate fabric movement, and premium cinematic VFX.

The entire 30-second video must be one physically continuous, real-time single take from beginning to end. No cuts, hidden cuts, transitions, time jumps, camera resets, or scene changes.

CORE TECHNICAL TEST

The real environment and both actors must remain completely identical throughout the entire 30 seconds. Every time the man physically presses the button, only the adult woman’s outfit comes alive like living fabric and transforms into the next stage over exactly two seconds.

Stage 1: A glamorous and sensual evening gown
Stage 2: Bold high-fashion streetwear
Stage 3: Luxurious, sensual, lightweight chiffon summer fashion lingerie
The face, identity, skin, hair, anatomy, body proportions, physique, and height of the woman ({{Mixed 1}}) must never change. The man, table, button, chair, background, lighting, and shadows must also remain unchanged. Only the woman’s clothing transforms.
Each transformation must last exactly two seconds. The current outfit must physically disassemble along its real seams and stitching lines. The separated fabric must remain visible and move continuously as it is sewn, woven, and reconstructed into the next outfit.

The clothing must never instantly switch or disappear. No digital morphing, crossfades, teleportation, liquid metal, smoke, fire, magical light, or holograms.

Every moving material must remain real fabric at all times. Individual threads, seams, stitching lines, hems, folds, fabric thickness, and fabric weight must be clearly visible. The fabric must never pass through the woman’s skin or body. It must physically slide, wrap, tighten, and move along the surface of her body.

The living fabric rapidly pulls, tightens, and changes direction, transmitting real physical force into the woman’s body. Each sudden pull drags her off balance, twists her posture, makes her stumble, and visibly startles her. She never deliberately poses during any transformation.

LOCATION AND CHARACTERS

A sophisticated modern fashion research laboratory illuminated by warm sunlight entering through large windows. Realistic ceiling lights, shelves filled with fabric samples and sewing tools, and a long black wooden table positioned in the center of the room.

A real adult man is seated in front of the table. Directly in front of his right hand is a small mechanical button mounted inside a brushed-metal casing.

A real adult woman stands approximately two meters away on the opposite side of the table, facing the man. At the beginning, she wears a loose beige linen blouse, straight-cut black trousers, and ordinary black shoes. She has absolutely no idea what the button does.

CAMERA

Begin slightly above and behind the man’s right shoulder in an over-the-shoulder composition. The foreground must simultaneously show the man’s shoulder, the side of his head, his right arm, his hand, and the button. Beyond the table, the woman’s entire body must remain clearly visible.

The same handheld camera slowly travels along the right edge of the table throughout the entire scene, gradually moving closer to the woman. Include subtle natural handheld movement, realistic parallax, focus breathing, and automatic exposure adjustment.

The camera must never teleport or pass through any object. All three button presses and the complete process of all three transformations must remain clearly visible within the same uninterrupted continuous shot.

0–4 SECONDS

An over-the-shoulder full-body composition from behind the man. The woman naturally shifts her weight onto one leg and looks at him with a puzzled expression.

The man looks at the woman and then lowers his gaze toward the button on the table.

Only quiet room ambience, breathing, and subtle fabric movement can be heard.

4–6 SECONDS — FIRST BUTTON PRESS: EVENING GOWN

The man presses the button with his right index finger. The physical button visibly travels downward and produces a crisp mechanical click.

Immediately, the woman’s blouse sleeves and collar, along with the waistband and hems of her trousers, begin moving by themselves. The seams rapidly unravel, stitches pull out in continuous lines, and the original clothing separates along its real construction seams into multiple pieces of cloth and long fabric strips.

None of the fabric disappears. It continues to cover her body safely while floating only a few centimeters away from her skin.

Like an intelligent living textile organism, the fabric rapidly coils around her shoulders, waist, and legs. The beige and black threads unravel, intersect, and weave themselves into lustrous crimson satin.

The fabric suddenly wraps tightly around the woman’s waist and yanks her sideways, causing her upper body to twist sharply. At the same time, a long strip of fabric rapidly circles her legs, knocking her off balance.

She gasps in surprise, throws both arms outward, and stumbles one step sideways while trying not to fall. Her eyes widen as she looks down at her own living clothes in disbelief.

In exactly two seconds, all the original fabric is reconstructed into a glamorous and sensual crimson satin evening gown: an asymmetrical off-the-shoulder neckline, exposed shoulders and upper back, a fitted and structured bodice, a sharply defined waistline, a high side slit, a long ankle-length flowing skirt, and black high heels.

The bodice physically pulls itself upward into the correct position. The neckline folds itself into shape, and the waist tightens to fit her figure. The long skirt drops naturally under real gravity.

The final loose threads rapidly stitch the seams closed. Once the dress is complete, every part of it becomes completely still.

6–10 SECONDS

The woman barely regains her balance and touches the waist of the dress. She gently lifts part of the satin skirt with one hand and releases it. The material falls naturally with realistic weight, folds, and inertia.

She looks at the man with an expression of complete disbelief.

The camera begins slowly traveling along the right side of the table. The man examines the result and places his finger over the button again.

10–12 SECONDS — SECOND BUTTON PRESS: STREETWEAR

The man presses the button for the second time. A second distinct mechanical click is heard.

The evening gown immediately comes alive again. The long skirt suddenly rises from the floor like the tail of a giant living textile creature. The woman recoils in surprise.

The skirt divides along its side slit and construction seams, separating into wide fabric ribbons that rotate rapidly around her thighs, hips, and torso.

The bodice unravels from its seams and slides away from her shoulders while remaining physically recognizable as real fabric. Threads rapidly travel between the separated pieces, weaving them into denim, leather, and ribbed textile.

The force of the spinning skirt pulls the woman’s hips violently to one side. At the same moment, a newly forming boot suddenly tightens around her calf, causing her knee to buckle.

She gives a short startled scream, loses her balance, and grabs the edge of the table with one hand. With her other hand, she tries to pull away a piece of fabric crawling over her shoulder, but it slips between her fingers and stitches itself into the new outfit.

In exactly two seconds, the evening gown is completely reconstructed into bold, sensual high-fashion streetwear: an open cropped black leather biker jacket resting over her shoulders, a fitted crimson ribbed halter-neck crop top, low-rise black distressed micro-denim shorts that securely cover her body, an asymmetrical belt with metallic ornaments, detachable sleeve accessories, and knee-high black platform boots.

The leather jacket settles precisely over both shoulders. The crop top tightens naturally around her body. The shorts’ waistband secures itself safely around her hips, while the boot laces rapidly tie themselves from bottom to top.

All fabric movement stops completely.

12–17 SECONDS

Still gripping the table, the woman breathes rapidly and struggles to regain her balance. She looks down in sequence at her exposed midriff, leather jacket, shorts, and boots, then turns toward the man with a confused and anxious expression.

The woman says:

“Wait—don’t press it again.”

The camera passes alongside the table and reaches a three-quarter medium-full shot of the woman. The man remains visible in the rear portion of the frame with his hand resting above the button.

After a brief hesitation, the man presses the button again.

17–19 SECONDS — THIRD BUTTON PRESS: LUXURY LIGHTWEIGHT CHIFFON SUMMER LINGERIE

A third mechanical click is heard.

The streetwear comes alive more violently than before. The leather jacket pulls both of the woman’s shoulders backward before separating into long, flexible black strips of fabric.

The platform-boot laces unravel at tremendous speed, and the physical material of the boots travels upward along her legs. The denim shorts divide along their seams into narrow ribbons, while the crop top begins unraveling into countless threads from its lower hem upward.

Every piece of fabric must continue safely covering the woman’s body throughout the entire transformation. Her clothing must never instantly disappear, and there must never be a moment in which she is nude.

Countless black fabric strips coil around her torso, waist, and legs like living creatures. The material folds, intersects, and reweaves itself into black silk, delicate lace, lightweight chiffon, and translucent mesh.

A long strip of fabric suddenly tightens hard around her waist, arching her upper body backward. At the same time, the newly forming stockings pull downward against her legs, causing both feet to slide across the floor.

The woman inhales sharply, flails both arms, and stumbles sideways. Her hip lightly bumps against the edge of the table, and she barely prevents herself from falling by planting one palm firmly on the tabletop.

Una película de acción en vivo extremadamente fotorrealista, en ultra alta resolución, con un interior contemporáneo real, actores adultos reales, textura natural de la piel, iluminación realista, movimiento de la tela físicamente preciso y VFX cinematográficos de primera calidad.

Todo el video de 30 segundos debe ser una única toma continua, físicamente ininterrumpida y en tiempo real, desde el principio hasta el final. Sin cortes, cortes ocultos, transiciones, saltos temporales, reinicios de cámara ni cambios de escena.

PRUEBA TÉCNICA CENTRAL

El entorno real y ambos actores deben permanecer completamente idénticos durante los 30 segundos completos. Cada vez que el hombre presione físicamente el botón, solo el atuendo de la mujer adulta cobrará vida como una tela viva y se transformará en la siguiente etapa en exactamente dos segundos.

Etapa 1: Un vestido de noche glamuroso y sensual  
Etapa 2: Streetwear de alta moda, audaz  
Etapa 3: Lencería de moda veraniega lujosa, sensual y ligera de gasa

El rostro, la identidad, la piel, el cabello, la anatomía, las proporciones corporales, la complexión y la altura de la mujer ({{Mixed 1}}) nunca deben cambiar. El hombre, la mesa, el botón, la silla, el fondo, la iluminación y las sombras también deben permanecer inalterados. Solo se transforma la ropa de la mujer.

Cada transformación debe durar exactamente dos segundos. El atuendo actual debe desarmarse físicamente siguiendo sus costuras y líneas de puntada reales. La tela separada debe permanecer visible y moverse de forma continua mientras se cose, se teje y se reconstruye en el siguiente atuendo.

La ropa nunca debe cambiar de forma instantánea ni desaparecer. Nada de morphing digital, fundidos, teletransportación, metal líquido, humo, fuego, luz mágica ni hologramas.

Todo material en movimiento debe seguir siendo tela real en todo momento. Los hilos individuales, costuras, líneas de puntada, dobladillos, pliegues, grosor de la tela y peso del tejido deben ser claramente visibles. La tela nunca debe atravesar la piel ni el cuerpo de la mujer. Debe deslizarse, envolverse, tensarse y moverse físicamente sobre la superficie de su cuerpo.

La tela viva tira rápidamente, se tensa y cambia de dirección, transmitiendo fuerza física real al cuerpo de la mujer. Cada tirón repentino la desequilibra, tuerce su postura, la hace tambalearse y la sobresalta visiblemente. Nunca posa deliberadamente durante ninguna transformación.

UBICACIÓN Y PERSONAJES

Un sofisticado laboratorio moderno de investigación de moda iluminado por la cálida luz del sol que entra por grandes ventanales. Luces de techo realistas, estantes llenos de muestras de tela y herramientas de costura, y una larga mesa de madera negra situada en el centro de la habitación.

Un hombre adulto real está sentado frente a la mesa. Justo delante de su mano derecha hay un pequeño botón mecánico montado dentro de una carcasa de metal cepillado.

Una mujer adulta real está de pie a unos dos metros, al otro lado de la mesa, mirando al hombre. Al comienzo, lleva una blusa holgada de lino beige, pantalones negros de corte recto y zapatos negros comunes. No tiene absolutamente ninguna idea de lo que hace el botón.

CÁMARA

Comenzar ligeramente por encima y detrás del hombro derecho del hombre, en una composición over-the-shoulder. El primer plano debe mostrar simultáneamente el hombro del hombre, el lateral de su cabeza, su brazo derecho, su mano y el botón. Más allá de la mesa, todo el cuerpo de la mujer debe permanecer claramente visible.

La misma cámara en mano se desplaza lentamente a lo largo del borde derecho de la mesa durante toda la escena, acercándose gradualmente a la mujer. Incluir un movimiento sutil y natural de cámara en mano, paralaje realista, breathing de enfoque y ajuste automático de exposición.

La cámara nunca debe teletransportarse ni atravesar ningún objeto. Las tres pulsaciones del botón y el proceso completo de las tres transformaciones deben permanecer claramente visibles dentro de la misma toma continua e ininterrumpida.

0–4 SEGUNDOS

Una composición full-body over-the-shoulder desde detrás del hombre. La mujer desplaza naturalmente su peso sobre una pierna y lo mira con una expresión confundida.

El hombre mira a la mujer y luego baja la vista hacia el botón sobre la mesa.

Solo se escuchan el ambiente silencioso de la habitación, la respiración y un sutil movimiento de la tela.

4–6 SEGUNDOS — PRIMERA PULSACIÓN DEL BOTÓN: VESTIDO DE NOCHE

El hombre presiona el botón con el índice de su mano derecha. El botón físico desciende visiblemente y produce un clic mecánico nítido.

Inmediatamente, las mangas y el cuello de la blusa de la mujer, junto con la cintura y los dobladillos de sus pantalones, comienzan a moverse por sí solos. Las costuras se deshacen rápidamente, las puntadas se extraen en líneas continuas y la ropa original se separa siguiendo sus costuras reales de construcción en múltiples piezas de tela y largas tiras de tejido.

Ninguna tela desaparece. Sigue cubriendo su cuerpo de forma segura mientras flota a solo unos centímetros de su piel.

Como un organismo textil vivo e inteligente, la tela se enrolla rápidamente alrededor de sus hombros, cintura y piernas. Los hilos beige y negros se deshacen, se cruzan y se tejen entre sí formando un satén carmesí lustroso.

La tela se envuelve de repente con fuerza alrededor de la cintura de la mujer y la tira hacia un lado, haciendo que la parte superior de su cuerpo se tuerza bruscamente. Al mismo tiempo, una larga tira de tela rodea rápidamente sus piernas, desequilibrándola.

Ella jadea sorprendida, extiende ambos brazos hacia afuera y da un paso tambaleante hacia un lado mientras intenta no caer. Sus ojos se abren de par en par mientras mira incrédula su propia ropa viva.

En exactamente dos segundos, toda la tela original se reconstruye en un vestido de noche glamuroso y sensual de satén carmesí: un escote asimétrico off-the-shoulder, hombros y parte superior de la espalda descubiertos, un corpiño ajustado y estructurado, una cintura marcadamente definida, una abertura alta lateral, una falda larga y fluida hasta los tobillos, y tacones altos negros.

El corpiño se eleva físicamente hasta la posición correcta. El escote se pliega hasta adoptar su forma, y la cintura se ajusta para ceñirse a su figura. La falda larga cae de manera natural bajo la gravedad real.

Los últimos hilos sueltos cosen rápidamente las costuras. Una vez que el vestido está completo, cada parte queda completamente inmóvil.

6–10 SEGUNDOS

La mujer apenas recupera el equilibrio y toca la cintura del vestido. Levanta suavemente una parte de la falda de satén con una mano y la suelta. El material cae de forma natural con peso, pliegues e inercia realistas.

Mira al hombre con una expresión de absoluta incredulidad.

La cámara comienza a desplazarse lentamente por el lado derecho de la mesa. El hombre examina el resultado y vuelve a colocar el dedo sobre el botón.

10–12 SEGUNDOS — SEGUNDA PULSACIÓN DEL BOTÓN: STREETWEAR

El hombre presiona el botón por segunda vez. Se escucha un segundo clic mecánico claramente distinto.

El vestido de noche cobra vida de nuevo de inmediato. La falda larga se eleva de repente desde el suelo como la cola de una gigantesca criatura textil viva. La mujer se echa hacia atrás, sorprendida.

El corpiño se deshace por sus costuras y se desliza fuera de sus hombros sin dejar de ser físicamente reconocible como tela real. Los hilos viajan rápidamente entre las piezas separadas, tejiéndolas en denim, cuero y tejido acanalado.

Ella suelta un breve grito de sorpresa, pierde el equilibrio y agarra el borde de la mesa con una mano. Con la otra, intenta apartar un trozo de tela que se arrastra sobre su hombro, pero este se le escapa entre los dedos y se cose a sí mismo en el nuevo atuendo.

30 secondes, vertical 9:16. Un film live-action extrêmement photoréaliste, en ultra-haute résolution, mettant en scène un véritable intérieur contemporain, de vrais acteurs adultes masculins et féminins, une texture de peau naturelle, un éclairage réaliste, un mouvement du tissu physiquement exact et des VFX cinématographiques haut de gamme.

La vidéo entière de 30 secondes doit être un seul plan-séquence physiquement continu, en temps réel, du début à la fin. Aucun cut, cut caché, transition, saut temporel, réinitialisation de caméra ou changement de scène.

TEST TECHNIQUE CENTRAL

L’environnement réel et les deux acteurs doivent rester complètement identiques pendant toute la durée des 30 secondes. Chaque fois que l’homme appuie physiquement sur le bouton, seule la tenue de la femme adulte s’anime comme un tissu vivant et se transforme en l’étape suivante en exactement deux secondes.

Étape 1 : Une robe de soirée glamour et sensuelle  
Étape 2 : Du streetwear audacieux de haute couture  
Étape 3 : Une lingerie de mode estivale luxueuse, sensuelle et légère en mousseline  
Le visage, l’identité, la peau, les cheveux, l’anatomie, les proportions du corps, la silhouette et la taille de la femme ({{Mixed 1}}) ne doivent jamais changer. L’homme, la table, le bouton, la chaise, l’arrière-plan, l’éclairage et les ombres doivent également rester inchangés. Seule la tenue de la femme se transforme.  
Chaque transformation doit durer exactement deux secondes. La tenue actuelle doit physiquement se désassembler le long de ses vraies coutures et lignes de piqûre. Le tissu séparé doit rester visible et se déplacer en continu pendant qu’il est cousu, tissé et reconstruit en la tenue suivante.

Les vêtements ne doivent jamais changer instantanément ni disparaître. Aucun morphing numérique, fondu enchaîné, téléportation, métal liquide, fumée, feu, lumière magique ou hologramme.

Chaque matériau en mouvement doit rester du vrai tissu en permanence. Les fils individuels, coutures, lignes de piqûre, ourlets, plis, épaisseur du tissu et poids du tissu doivent être clairement visibles. Le tissu ne doit jamais traverser la peau ou le corps de la femme. Il doit physiquement glisser, s’enrouler, se tendre et se déplacer à la surface de son corps.

Le tissu vivant tire rapidement, se tend et change de direction, transmettant une véritable force physique au corps de la femme. Chaque traction soudaine la déséquilibre, tord sa posture, la fait trébucher et la surprend visiblement. Elle ne prend jamais volontairement la pose pendant une transformation.

LIEU ET PERSONNAGES

Un laboratoire de recherche de mode moderne et sophistiqué, éclairé par une lumière solaire chaude entrant par de grandes fenêtres. Des plafonniers réalistes, des étagères remplies d’échantillons de tissus et d’outils de couture, ainsi qu’une longue table en bois noir placée au centre de la pièce.

Un homme adulte réel est assis devant la table. Juste devant sa main droite se trouve un petit bouton mécanique monté dans un boîtier en métal brossé.

Une femme adulte réelle se tient à environ deux mètres, de l’autre côté de la table, face à l’homme. Au début, elle porte une blouse ample en lin beige, un pantalon noir à coupe droite et des chaussures noires ordinaires. Elle n’a absolument aucune idée de ce que fait le bouton.

CAMÉRA

Commencer légèrement au-dessus et derrière l’épaule droite de l’homme, dans une composition en over-the-shoulder. Le premier plan doit montrer simultanément l’épaule de l’homme, le côté de sa tête, son bras droit, sa main et le bouton. Au-delà de la table, le corps entier de la femme doit rester clairement visible.

La même caméra à main levée se déplace lentement le long du bord droit de la table pendant toute la scène, en se rapprochant progressivement de la femme. Inclure un léger mouvement naturel de caméra à main levée, une parallaxe réaliste, un focus breathing et une adaptation automatique de l’exposition.

La caméra ne doit jamais se téléporter ni traverser un objet. Les trois pressions du bouton et le processus complet des trois transformations doivent rester clairement visibles dans le même plan continu ininterrompu.

0–4 SECONDES

Une composition plein corps en over-the-shoulder depuis derrière l’homme. La femme déplace naturellement son poids sur une jambe et le regarde avec une expression perplexe.

L’homme regarde la femme puis baisse le regard vers le bouton sur la table.

On n’entend que l’ambiance calme de la pièce, la respiration et un léger mouvement du tissu.

4–6 SECONDES — PREMIÈRE PRESSION DU BOUTON : ROBE DE SOIRÉE

L’homme appuie sur le bouton avec l’index de sa main droite. Le bouton physique s’enfonce visiblement et produit un clic mécanique net.

Immédiatement, les manches et le col de la blouse de la femme, ainsi que la ceinture et les ourlets de son pantalon, commencent à bouger d’eux-mêmes. Les coutures se défont rapidement, les points se retirent en lignes continues, et le vêtement d’origine se sépare le long de ses vraies coutures de construction en plusieurs morceaux de tissu et longues bandes de tissu.

Aucun tissu ne disparaît. Il continue à couvrir son corps en toute sécurité tout en flottant à seulement quelques centimètres de sa peau.

Comme un organisme textile vivant intelligent, le tissu s’enroule rapidement autour de ses épaules, de sa taille et de ses jambes. Les fils beige et noirs se défont, s’entrecroisent et se tissent en satin cramoisi lustré.

Le tissu s’enroule soudainement et fermement autour de la taille de la femme et la tire de côté, provoquant une torsion brutale de son buste. Au même moment, une longue bande de tissu fait rapidement le tour de ses jambes, la déséquilibrant.

Elle halète de surprise, écarte les deux bras et fait un pas de côté en trébuchant, essayant de ne pas tomber. Ses yeux s’écarquillent tandis qu’elle regarde, incrédule, ses propres vêtements vivants.

En exactement deux secondes, tout le tissu d’origine est reconstruit en une robe de soirée glamour et sensuelle en satin cramoisi : un décolleté asymétrique épaules dénudées, des épaules et le haut du dos exposés, un corsage ajusté et structuré, une taille nettement marquée, une fente haute sur le côté, une longue jupe fluide jusqu’aux chevilles et des talons hauts noirs.

Le corsage se tire physiquement vers le haut pour se placer correctement. Le décolleté se replie pour prendre sa forme, et la taille se resserre pour épouser sa silhouette. La longue jupe retombe naturellement sous l’effet de la gravité réelle.

Les derniers fils lâches cousent rapidement les coutures. Une fois la robe terminée, chaque partie devient complètement immobile.

6–10 SECONDES

La femme retrouve à peine son équilibre et touche la taille de la robe. Elle soulève doucement une partie de la jupe en satin d’une main puis la relâche. Le tissu retombe naturellement avec un poids, des plis et une inertie réalistes.

Elle regarde l’homme avec une expression de totale incrédulité.

La caméra commence à se déplacer lentement le long du côté droit de la table. L’homme examine le résultat et pose de nouveau son doigt sur le bouton.

10–12 SECONDES — DEUXIÈME PRESSION DU BOUTON : STREETWEAR

L’homme appuie sur le bouton pour la deuxième fois. Un deuxième clic mécanique distinct se fait entendre.

La robe de soirée s’anime immédiatement à nouveau. La longue jupe se soulève soudain du sol comme la queue d’une gigantesque créature textile vivante. La femme recule, surprise.

La jupe se divise le long de sa fente latérale et de ses coutures de construction, se séparant en larges rubans de tissu qui tournent rapidement autour de ses cuisses, de ses hanches et de son buste.

Le corsage se défait au niveau de ses coutures et glisse hors de ses épaules tout en restant physiquement reconnaissable comme du vrai tissu. Des fils circulent rapidement entre les pièces séparées, les tissant en denim, cuir et textile côtelé.

La force de la jupe en rotation tire violemment les hanches de la femme d’un côté. Au même moment, une botte en cours de formation se resserre soudain autour de son mollet, faisant fléchir son genou.

Elle pousse un petit cri de surprise, perd l’équilibre et agrippe le bord de la table d’une main. De l’autre main, elle essaie d’arracher un morceau de tissu qui rampe sur son épaule, mais il glisse entre ses doigts et se coud dans la nouvelle tenue.

En exactement deux secondes, la robe de soirée est complètement reconstruite en un streetwear de haute couture audacieux et sensuel : une veste biker noire en cuir, courte et ouverte, reposant sur ses épaules,

30秒、縦型9:16。現代的な実在の室内、実在の成人男性・女性俳優、自然な肌の質感、リアルなライティング、物理的に正確な布の動き、そして高品質なシネマティックVFXを備えた、極めてフォトリアルで超高解像度の実写映画。

30초, 세로 9:16. 실제 현대적 실내 공간, 실제 성인 남녀 배우, 자연스러운 피부 질감, 사실적인 조명, 물리적으로 정확한 천의 움직임, 프리미엄 시네마틱 VFX를 특징으로 하는 극도로 포토리얼하고 초고해상도의 실사 영화.

전체 30초 영상은 시작부터 끝까지 물리적으로 연속된, 실시간 단일 테이크여야 한다. 컷, 숨겨진 컷, 전환, 시간 점프, 카메라 리셋, 장면 전환은 절대 없어야 한다.

핵심 기술 테스트

실제 환경과 두 배우는 30초 내내 완전히 동일하게 유지되어야 한다. 남자가 물리적으로 버튼을 누를 때마다, 성인 여성의 의상만 살아 있는 천처럼 움직이며 정확히 2초에 걸쳐 다음 단계로 변형된다.

Stage 1: A glamorous and sensual evening gown  
Stage 2: Bold high-fashion streetwear  
Stage 3: Luxurious, sensual, lightweight chiffon summer fashion lingerie  
여성({{Mixed 1}})의 얼굴, 정체성, 피부, 머리카락, 해부학적 구조, 신체 비율, 체형, 키는 절대 변하면 안 된다. 남자, 테이블, 버튼, 의자, 배경, 조명, 그림자 역시 변하지 않아야 한다. 오직 여성의 의상만 변형된다.  
각 변형은 정확히 2초 동안 지속되어야 한다. 현재 의상은 실제 봉제선과 스티치 라인을 따라 물리적으로 분해되어야 한다. 분리된 천은 계속 보이는 상태로 유지되며, 다음 의상으로 재봉되고, 직조되고, 재구성되는 동안 끊임없이 움직여야 한다.

의상은 절대로 즉시 바뀌거나 사라져서는 안 된다. 디지털 모핑, 크로스페이드, 순간이동, 액체 금속, 연기, 불, 마법 같은 빛, 홀로그램은 금지된다.

움직이는 모든 소재는 항상 실제 천이어야 한다. 개별 실, 솔기, 스티치 라인, 밑단, 주름, 천의 두께, 천의 무게가 명확히 보여야 한다. 천은 절대로 여성의 피부나 몸을 통과해서는 안 된다. 반드시 그녀의 몸 표면을 따라 물리적으로 미끄러지고, 감싸고, 조여지고, 움직여야 한다.

살아 있는 천은 빠르게 당겨지고, 조여지고, 방향을 바꾸며 여성의 몸에 실제 물리적 힘을 전달한다. 갑작스러운 당김마다 그녀는 균형을 잃고, 자세가 비틀리고, 비틀거리며, 눈에 띄게 놀란다. 어떤 변형 중에도 그녀가 의도적으로 포즈를 취하는 일은 없다.

장소와 등장인물

큰 창문으로 들어오는 따뜻한 햇빛이 비추는 세련된 현대 패션 연구소. 사실적인 천장 조명, 원단 샘플과 재봉 도구로 가득한 선반, 그리고 방 중앙에 놓인 긴 검은색 나무 테이블.

실제 성인 남성이 테이블 앞에 앉아 있다. 그의 오른손 바로 앞에는 브러시드 메탈 케이스 안에 장착된 작은 기계식 버튼이 있다.

실제 성인 여성이 테이블 맞은편에서 남자를 향해 약 2미터 떨어진 곳에 서 있다. 시작 시 그녀는 헐렁한 베이지색 리넨 블라우스, 일자 검정 바지, 평범한 검정 신발을 착용하고 있다. 그녀는 버튼이 무엇을 하는지 전혀 모른다.

카메라

남자의 오른쪽 어깨 뒤 약간 위에서 시작하는 오버 더 숄더 구도. 전경에는 남자의 어깨, 머리 옆면, 오른팔, 손, 버튼이 동시에 보여야 한다. 테이블 너머로 여성의 전신이 선명하게 보여야 한다.

같은 핸드헬드 카메라는 장면 전체 동안 테이블의 오른쪽 가장자리를 따라 천천히 이동하며 점차 여성에게 가까워진다. 미세한 자연스러운 핸드헬드 움직임, 사실적인 시차, 포커스 브리딩, 자동 노출 조정을 포함한다.

카메라는 절대로 순간이동하거나 어떤 물체도 통과해서는 안 된다. 세 번의 버튼 누름과 세 번의 변형 과정 전체가 같은 끊김 없는 연속 샷 안에서 모두 선명하게 보여야 한다.

0–4초

남자의 뒤에서 본 오버 더 숄더 전신 구도. 여성은 자연스럽게 한쪽 다리에 체중을 싣고, 의아한 표정으로 그를 바라본다.

남자는 여성을 바라보다가 테이블 위 버튼 쪽으로 시선을 내린다.

들리는 소리는 조용한 실내 분위기, 호흡, 그리고 미세한 천의 움직임뿐이다.

4–6초 — 첫 번째 버튼 누름: 이브닝 가운

남자가 오른손 검지로 버튼을 누른다. 물리적인 버튼이 눈에 띄게 아래로 내려가며 또렷한 기계음 클릭이 난다.

즉시 여성의 블라우스 소매와 칼라, 그리고 바지의 허리밴드와 밑단이 스스로 움직이기 시작한다. 솔기가 빠르게 풀리고, 스티치가 연속적인 선으로 뽑혀 나오며, 원래 의상은 실제 구조선에 따라 여러 조각의 천과 긴 천 조각으로 분리된다.

어떤 천도 사라지지 않는다. 천은 그녀의 몸을 안전하게 덮은 채, 피부에서 불과 몇 센티미터 떨어진 상태로 떠 있다.

지능을 가진 살아 있는 섬유 생물처럼, 천은 그녀의 어깨, 허리, 다리 주위를 빠르게 감아 돈다. 베이지색과 검정색 실이 풀리고, 교차하고, 서로 엮이며 광택 있는 진홍색 새틴으로 변해 간다.

천이 갑자기 여성의 허리를 강하게 조여 옆으로 잡아당기면서 상체가 크게 비틀린다. 동시에 긴 천 조각이 그녀의 다리 주위를 빠르게 휘감아 균형을 무너뜨린다.

그녀는 놀라 숨을 들이쉬고 양팔을 밖으로 뻗으며, 넘어지지 않으려 옆으로 한 걸음 비틀거린다. 자신의 살아 움직이는 옷을 내려다보며 믿을 수 없다는 듯 눈을 크게 뜬다.

정확히 2초 안에, 모든 원래 천은 화려하고 관능적인 진홍색 새틴 이브닝 가운으로 재구성된다: 비대칭 오프숄더 네크라인, 드러난 어깨와 상부 등, 몸에 꼭 맞는 구조적인 보디스, 또렷하게 잡힌 허리선, 높은 옆트임, 발목 길이의 길게 흐르는 스커트, 그리고 검정 하이힐.

보디스는 물리적으로 스스로 위로 당겨져 올바른 위치에 자리 잡는다. 네크라인은 스스로 형태를 잡고, 허리는 그녀의 체형에 맞게 조여진다. 긴 스커트는 실제 중력에 따라 자연스럽게 떨어진다.

마지막으로 남은 느슨한 실들이 빠르게 솔기를 꿰매 닫는다. 드레스가 완성되면 모든 부분이 완전히 정지한다.

6–10초

여성은 간신히 균형을 되찾고 드레스의 허리 부분을 만진다. 한 손으로 새틴 스커트 일부를 부드럽게 들어 올렸다가 놓는다. 소재는 실제 무게, 주름, 관성에 따라 자연스럽게 떨어진다.

그녀는 완전히 믿을 수 없다는 표정으로 남자를 바라본다.

카메라는 테이블 오른쪽을 따라 천천히 이동하기 시작한다. 남자는 결과를 살펴보고 다시 버튼 위에 손가락을 올린다.

10–12초 — 두 번째 버튼 누름: 스트리트웨어

남자가 두 번째로 버튼을 누른다. 또 한 번의 분명한 기계식 클릭이 들린다.

이브닝 가운이 다시 즉시 살아 움직인다. 긴 스커트가 거대한 살아 있는 섬유 생물의 꼬리처럼 바닥에서 갑자기 솟아오른다. 여성은 놀라 몸을 움찔한다.

스커트는 옆트임과 구조선 따라 갈라지며, 허벅지, 엉덩이, 몸통 주위를 빠르게 회전하는 넓은 천 리본으로 분리된다.

30 segundos, vertical 9:16. Um filme live-action extremamente fotorrealista, em ultra-alta resolução, com um interior contemporâneo real, atores adultos reais, textura natural da pele, iluminação realista, movimento de tecido fisicamente preciso e VFX cinematográficos premium.

O vídeo inteiro de 30 segundos deve ser um único take fisicamente contínuo e em tempo real, do começo ao fim. Sem cortes, cortes ocultos, transições, saltos no tempo, resets de câmera ou mudanças de cena.

TESTE TÉCNICO CENTRAL

O ambiente real e os dois atores devem permanecer completamente idênticos durante todos os 30 segundos. Toda vez que o homem pressionar fisicamente o botão, apenas a roupa da mulher adulta ganha vida como tecido vivo e se transforma para a próxima etapa em exatamente dois segundos.

Etapa 1: Um vestido de gala glamouroso e sensual  
Etapa 2: Streetwear ousado de alta moda  
Etapa 3: Lingerie de moda de verão luxuosa, sensual e leve em chiffon

O rosto, a identidade, a pele, o cabelo, a anatomia, as proporções corporais, o físico e a altura da mulher ({{Mixed 1}}) nunca devem mudar. O homem, a mesa, o botão, a cadeira, o fundo, a iluminação e as sombras também devem permanecer inalterados. Apenas as roupas da mulher se transformam.

Cada transformação deve durar exatamente dois segundos. A roupa atual deve se desmontar fisicamente ao longo de suas costuras e linhas reais de costura. O tecido separado deve permanecer visível e se mover continuamente enquanto é costurado, tecido e reconstruído na próxima roupa.
